title: First Week After Launch
description: Post-launch monitoring for new sites — forms, analytics, errors, and search visibility during the critical first seven days.

steps.title: Monitor Uptime Daily
steps.instructions: Check uptime alerts or host status each day. Investigate any downtime or slow response immediately.

steps.title: Re-test Forms & Checkout
steps.instructions: Submit contact forms and complete a test purchase if e-commerce. Confirm emails and webhooks still work.

steps.title: Review PHP & Server Error Logs
steps.instructions: Scan error logs for PHP warnings, fatal errors, and 500 responses. Fix issues before they affect visitors.

steps.title: Confirm Analytics Tracking
steps.instructions: Verify GA4 or Site Kit shows page views and key events. Compare traffic to pre-launch expectations.

steps.title: Check Search Console Coverage
steps.instructions: Look for indexing errors, sitemap processing status, and manual actions in the first week after go-live.

steps.title: Collect Client & User Feedback
steps.instructions: Ask the client to browse on phone and desktop. Log UX issues, typos, and missing content for quick fixes.

steps.title: Send Week-One Summary
steps.instructions: Email a brief launch summary: what went live, monitoring results, open items, and next maintenance date.
